osm_tags.name: London Victoria
osm_tags.wheelchair:description: Concourse to platforms step-free & wide gates. Access to all trains by portable ramps, no Harrington Humps discovered yet.

osm_tags.note: In the car park area above the station, either enter via car park entrance on Eccleston Bridge or carry bike upstairs through Victoria Place from station concourse
